Name: Set Mission Counter
Description: Sets one configured counter through its native setter. When the game has enabled this widget's events, crossing zero or maximum runs normal mission events, which may grant rewards, change persistent flags, end a mission or change rooms. Uses the current counter's maximum and preserves native threshold effects.
RestoreBehavior: One-time native action. No undo, profile replay, automatic retry or save export. Native event/reward/transition effects remain in force.

Evidence.Finding: Uses the full native setter once after fresh mission/widget/code/phase validation. Boundary actions validate loaded event/BDX/Actor/HUD structures. No previous mission pointer is read after return.
Evidence.Level: Full dedicated IDA assembly and isolated synthetic guards/lifecycle tests; no live test.

Name: Set Mission Score
Description: Sets configured mission score from 0 to 9999 through the native score object's setter. Preserves repetition history and reward multipliers. Later score-to-EXP conversion, results and other mission effects use the new score.
